title: Make GoalLibraryModal goal list scrollable within the modal

requirements.summary: Adjust GoalLibraryModal layout so only the goal list region scrolls (desktop wheel/trackpad + mobile swipe) while modal header/tabs/footer remain fixed, preventing background page scroll.
acceptanceCriteria: When the GoalLibraryModal opens, the goal list area supports scrolling via mouse wheel/trackpad on desktop.
On touch devices, the goal list area supports vertical swipe scrolling inside the modal.
Scrolling does not move the page behind the modal; only the list scrolls.
Users can scroll to any goal template in the current tab/category and select it (checkbox or card click) without the modal closing unintentionally.
The modal header/tabs area and footer action buttons remain visible while the list scrolls (i.e., only the list region scrolls).

file_operations.description: Fix modal internal scrolling by ensuring the goal-list container is the only scrollable region: keep DialogContent/Tabs layout as a flex column with proper min-h-0 on scroll parents, replace or reconfigure the current ScrollArea usage so it has a definite constrained height, and apply scroll-chaining prevention (e.g., overscroll containment) so wheel/touch scroll stays within the list and does not scroll the page behind the modal. Also prevent scroll/touch events inside the list from propagating to the dialog overlay and avoid accidental modal close while selecting. If continuing to use the shadcn ScrollArea component, verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
